question.text: The point $Q$ is the image of the point $P(1,5)$ about the line $y=x$ and $R$ is the image of the point $Q$ about the line $y=-x .$ The circumcentre of the $\Delta P Q R$ is

solution.text: Given, point P(1,5) image of the point $P(1,5)$ about the line $y=x$ is $Q(5,1)$ and image of the point $Q$ on line $y=-x$ is $R(-1,-5)$ $\therefore$ Required circumcentre $=$ Mid-point of $P$ and $R$ $=\left(\frac{1-1}{2}, \frac{5-5}{2}\right)=(0,0$
